name: askdock-transcript-row
description: the questions widget is the transcript's trailing row: it sizes to its content (no internal scroll), centers on the 76rem reading measure, and leaves the transcript's allocation and the footer untouched however tall the batch - the transcript alone scrolls

mutation.declaration: widgets/panescaffold/panescaffold.module.css: .body { overflow-y: auto } (transcript scroll ownership) - without it the tall batch stretches the pane instead of scrolling inside the transcript
mutation.note: Verified by hand: reverting to overflow-y: visible fails the case with 'transcript overflow belongs to visible, not the pane body'.
